title: Intel security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-066.112217: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Intel Security Updates
leadParagraph: Intel has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in the firmware of the following Intel products: Management Engine, Server Platform Services, and Trusted Execution Engine. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.
contentHtml:
Intel has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in the firmware of the following Intel products: Management Engine, Server Platform Services, and Trusted Execution Engine. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system.

Further information on these vulnerabilities and how they can be fixed can be found on Intel Website at https://security-center.intel.com/advisory.aspx?intelid=INTEL-SA-00086&languageid=en-fr
